newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Usiminas still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Usiminas still a buy.

text.p: Salomon Brothers and its associate Banco Patrimonio said Monday it has reiterated its buy recommendation on Brazilian steelmaker Usiminas following the release of second quarter results.
-- "Usiminas represents one of the best investment opportunities in the Brazilian flat steel industry," Salomon analyst Mauricio Reveco said in a report.

-- He said the company's second quarter adjusted net income of 73.9 million reais, up 61.4 percent from the same period last year, was in line with forecasts for a full-year net income of 2280.1 million reais.
-- The rise in earnings was due mostly to high shipment levels, higher sales in the domestic market and a reduction in costs and expenses, Reveco said.
-- He said crude steel production was 1.077 million tons in the second quarter compared with 1.025 million tonnes in the first quarter and 932,000 tonnes in second quarter 1996.
-- Reveco said operating results "were superb" as operating costs, as a percentage of net sales, dropped to 9.8 percent from 10.4 percent.
-- "For 1997 and 1998, we reaffirm our positive outlook for the company's net profit growth," he added.
-- Usiminas preferred was off 0.45 percent at 11.10 reais at 1647 local time/1547 EDT in Sao Paulo.
